t: Transparent wood finish offers a smooth surface and resistance to dirt, water and abrasion. Simple application without the need for primer or sanding between coats. Microporous surface will not crack, peel, flake or blister. Resistant to saliva, perspiration, and liquids such as wine, beer, cola, coffee, tea, fruit juice and milk. Dry finish is safe for humans, animals and plants. Ideal for veneered doors and furniture. Suitable for childrens toys.
